nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address used by ensure(), delegate(), init(), batchSend() and setTradeAddress()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals mutated in approve() and consumed in transferFrom()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition()
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist bypassing the sale condition in ensure()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced by condition(), set in init()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced by condition(), set in init()
uint256 private _saleNum; per-address sale count limit enforced by condition(), set in init()
address tradeAddress; trusted address that bypasses the sale condition in ensure()
uint public totalSupply; fixed at construction time, never minted or burned afterwards
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in constructor and init()
string public name; token name set in the constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in the constructor
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure()
transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and the derived pair, otherwise calls condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; spends allowance and mutates balanceOf/_onSaleNum with raw unchecked arithmetic
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale thresholds
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall entry point
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public; owner-only sale configuration, declares bool return but never returns a value
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only mass balance credit with unchecked multiplication and no token transfer out
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes the CREATE2 Uniswap pair address used by ensure()
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for authorization checks and allowance accounting throughout the contract
a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary, owner-supplied address executing attacker-controlled bytecode in this contract's storage context
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked arithmetic (Solidity 0.5) instead of SafeMath
uint total = _value * _tos.length; unchecked multiplication allowing overflow and an inconsistent balance debit
init() declares returns(bool) but contains no return statement, so every call reverts when decoding the result

transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transfer() uses msg.sender as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and only spends allowance when they differ
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked subtraction/addition
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer
transferFrom executes raw Solidity 0.5 arithmetic on allowance and balances without SafeMath
ensure() bypasses the sale condition for _from or _to equal to the privileged owner
ensure() whitelists any address present in the canSale mapping
ensure() bypasses the sale condition when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure() bypasses the sale condition when _from equals the hardcoded UNI router constant
ensure() falls back to condition(_from,_value) and requires it to be true
ensure() calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address
condition() rejects transfers below _minSale
condition() rejects transfers above _maxSale
condition() limits the number of sales via _saleNum
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall after an owner-only require
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall
the delegatecall target executes in this contract's storage context and can overwrite the owner slot
init() requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring the sale parameters
init() assigns the scaled token value to _minSale
init() assigns the scaled maxToken value to _maxSale
init() assigns saleNum to _saleNum
init() uses decimals to scale the min and max sale values
init() declares a bool return value but never reaches a return statement
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender]
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] for every recipient with unchecked arithmetic
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
setTradeAddress() writes a new whitelisted tradeAddress that bypasses ensure()
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner
the constructor reads msg.sender to establish the owner
the constructor stores the _name argument in name
the constructor stores the _symbol argument in symbol
the constructor stores _supply scaled by decimals in totalSupply
the constructor uses the decimals constant to scale the supply
the constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
the constructor pre-approves the Uniswap router with an unlimited allowance
the constructor assigns the deployer as owner, granting access to every privileged function
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance protection
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
transfer() ultimately mutates the balanceOf mapping through transferFrom
